tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background: the white ground every layer sits on. Also the ink on `text` fills (selected segment, solid chip) and on dark ramp steps; `on-accent` covers the primary button only.

tokens.name: layer-1
tokens.usage: First layer on the page: sheets, panels, index cards, the memo head, the rail. Pair with a `line-width` `line` border; elevation is fill plus hairline, not shadow.

tokens.name: layer-2
tokens.usage: Second layer: insets nested in a sheet, callouts, chips, inline code, segmented-control tracks, hover fill. Text on it is `text`, never `text-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The hairline: `line-width` borders on layers, row dividers in lists and tables, the gaps between panel cells.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Heavy rule at `line-width`: under table headers, the border of a highlighted index card, the strong chip.

tokens.name: line-dashed
tokens.usage: Non-text strokes only: dashed borders for absent items and incidents. Too faint for text, so never set type in it.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, numerals, and the bold lede-in that leads a muted paragraph. Reads on `page`, `layer-1` and `layer-2` in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: support prose, meta lines, mono labels, table headers. Reads on `page` and `layer-1` only; on `layer-2` use `text`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Used in exactly two roles: the focus ring and the primary button fill. Equals `text` in the default preset.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: the primary button.

tokens.name: scale-1
tokens.usage: Value ramp step 1 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-1-ink`. Outline it with an inset `line` ring on light grounds.

tokens.name: scale-2
tokens.usage: Value ramp step 2 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-2-ink`.

tokens.name: scale-3
tokens.usage: Value ramp step 3 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-3-ink`.

tokens.name: scale-4
tokens.usage: Value ramp step 4 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-4-ink`.

tokens.name: scale-5
tokens.usage: Value ramp step 5 of 5, light to dark ink weight. Ordinal data only (the mild-to-wild ladder, meters, tier swatches). Set text on it in `scale-5-ink`.

tokens.name: scale-1-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `scale-1` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

tokens.name: scale-2-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `scale-2` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

tokens.name: scale-3-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `scale-3` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

tokens.name: scale-4-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `scale-4` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

tokens.name: scale-5-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a `scale-5` fill. Flips between `text` and `page` by theme so every step is meant to meet 4.5:1.

color.note: Monochrome by design: no hue anywhere. A white page, two flat grey layers, one hairline. Accent equals text.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Pick a direction before the build
styles.usage: Page title (h1). Class `title`. Drops to 32px under 600px (bundle.css). Balanced wrap.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Ship the rail page as the default; keep memo for one-answer notes.
styles.usage: The answer sentence. Class `lead`. Drops to 21px under 600px (bundle.css).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heading (h2), every mode. Class `heading` on `.os-sh`.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Which page mode is the default?
styles.usage: Row and card titles: decision questions, index answers, the memo head RE line. Class `subhead`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every page answers first, then shows the decisions, then the evidence.
styles.usage: Default prose. Put class `body` on `<body>`. Prose blocks cap at `layout-measure`.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Rail keeps the answer in view while the evidence scrolls.
styles.usage: Secondary prose: decision rationale, sub-bullets, ledger rows, table cells. Class `body-sm`.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Ordinal data only; never a status color.
styles.usage: Notes, ramp captions, panel-mode base size. Class `caption`.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Tally numerals above a mono label. Class `stat`; tabular numerals. In panel mode use `title` for hero numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: Version · Shipped · Days to a fix
styles.usage: Mono data role only: table and tally headers, scale steps, row keys, the toc, chips. Never an eyebrow, kicker or section head. Class `label`; bundle.css adds uppercase and `text-muted`.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Mono cells: dates, IDs, counts, first table column, kv values. Class `data`; tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: ramp swatch gap, chip vertical padding, icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: chip horizontal padding, label-to-content, list item gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Row padding in dense lists and tables; card grid gap on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Default component gap; row padding; page gutter under 600px.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Sheet padding on mobile; gap between index cards.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked sheets; row padding in decision lists; sheet padding in rail.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between sections in memo mode; sheet padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large sheet padding (answer sheet, twin sheets) on desktop.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Space above a page title; between major blocks in report mode.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Section rhythm in report and poster modes; page bottom padding.

tokens.name: layout-measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for prose blocks in every mode (about 68 characters; em so it tracks the block's own size).

tokens.name: layout-read
tokens.usage: Container width for memo mode (single reading column).

tokens.name: layout-report
tokens.usage: Container width for rail (default) and report modes.

tokens.name: layout-wide
tokens.usage: Container width for panel mode.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding at 860px and up; `space-32` from 600px; `space-16` below.

tokens.name: layout-rail
tokens.usage: Sticky question column in report mode; side table of contents.

tokens.name: layout-label
tokens.usage: Label column in a label | body strip row and the memo key-value head; collapses above the body under 600px.

spacing.note: Ten steps on a 4px base, then layout widths.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Layer-1 surfaces: sheets, panels, cards, index cards, segmented-control track. Nothing larger than 12px anywhere.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Layer-2 and controls: chips, insets, inputs, buttons, ramp swatches, segment thumbs. A 10px container with 4px padding holds 6px children.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: True circles only: dots and discs. Never pills on text chips.

tokens.name: radius-tick
tokens.usage: Micro marks: pips.

radius.note: Two radii do the work: 10 for layers, 6 for what sits inside them. Nothing larger than 12px.

shadow.note: One faint shadow per page, never in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The page's one shadow, via `.os-lift` on the decisions sheet. Dark theme: none (no glows).

border.note: Stroke widths. Colors come from `line`, `line-strong`, `line-dashed`, `text` and `accent`.

tokens.name: line-width
tokens.usage: Every hairline and rule: layer borders, row dividers, `line-strong` rules, dashed absent-item borders, the gap between panel cells.

tokens.name: ring-width
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: a solid `accent` outline at this width on every focusable element.
